findings.subject: separator
findings.summary: A vertical Separator collapses to zero height in any flex row whose height is not fixed, so it is invisible in the Themes contact sheet for all 8 theme x mode combinations.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/separator/separator.css:18-22 (height:100% plus align-self:stretch; the percentage is indefinite and prevents stretch); apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-separator-themes-chromium-linux.png shows Home / Docs / About with no dividers, while ui-react-separator-vertical-chromium-linux.png shows them only because separator.stories.tsx:38 fixes the parent height to 24px.
findings.fix: Drop height:100% for vertical (leave height auto so align-self:stretch fills the row, with a min-block-size such as 1em as a floor), add a test that a vertical separator in an align-items:center row has a non-zero height, and re-baseline Themes.

verified.reason: separator.css:18-22 gives the vertical separator height:100% as well as align-self:stretch. Flexbox only stretches an item whose cross size computes to auto, and 100% is not auto, so stretch is ignored. The percentage then resolves against a parent row with no set height, so it acts as auto, and an empty element gets 0px. I reproduced this from the source: the Themes story (separator.stories.tsx:76-95, a flex row with no height) shows no dividers in any of the 8 theme x mode rows of ui-react-separator-themes-chromium-linux.png. The Vertical story renders them only because its row sets height:24 (stories:38). ButtonGroup, ToggleGroup and similar components draw their own separators in their own CSS, so the bug hits the standalone Separator in its usual inline-row use. That is broken output that blocks ready, so P1 stands.

findings.subject: accordion
findings.summary: Accordion drops its own a63-Accordion class whenever a consumer passes className.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/accordion/accordion.tsx:118-131: className={cn('a63-Accordion')} is set before {...props}, and className is not destructured, so props.className overwrites it.
findings.fix: Destructure className and pass cn('a63-Accordion', className); add a test that a custom class merges.

findings.subject: collapsible
findings.summary: The collapsible docs never say the trigger is unstyled and must render a Button, and the example shadows the DS Frame with a local component.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 component collapsible` guidance; `pnpm -s atom63 example collapsible Playground` (local function Frame, inline border/radius styles, collapsible.stories.tsx:30-41).
findings.fix: Add a usage line: "Render the trigger as <Button variant='ghost'> (render prop); the recipe draws no chrome", and rename the local helper / use a DS surface in the example.

findings.subject: collapsible
findings.summary: CollapsibleTrigger has no focus-visible style of its own, and no disclosure pattern test exists.
findings.fix: Add a focus-visible outline on .a63-Collapsible-trigger for the bare case, and a disclosure APG pattern (Enter/Space toggle, aria-expanded) bound to collapsible and connected-panel.

findings.subject: collapsible
findings.summary: Only the open state of the collapsible is captured; closed and disabled have no baseline.
findings.evidence: collapsible.stories.tsx:46 defaultOpen in every story; ui-react-collapsible-*.png.
findings.fix: Add closed and disabled stories.

findings.subject: collapsible
findings.summary: The collapsible tests skip keyboard toggling, controlled open and disabled.
findings.fix: Add Enter/Space toggle, controlled open/onOpenChange and disabled tests.

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: Every resize handle gets the same English label, and the hairline vanishes in forced colors.
findings.fix: Require or derive a per-handle label (for example from the panels it separates), and add a forced-colors rule painting the line in CanvasText.

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: The resizable contract lists a disabled state, but the recipe has no disabled style and no story shows one.
findings.fix: Style the disabled handle (default cursor, muted line, no hover) and add a story.

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: No resizable test exercises keyboard or pointer resizing.
findings.fix: Add arrow-key resize and aria-valuenow tests on the handle.

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: Resizable has no phone-width story.
findings.fix: Add a 390px story showing the panel minimums and a vertical fallback.

findings.subject: scroll-area
findings.summary: The scroll-area thumb is a hidden background fill with no forced-colors handling, so there is no scroll indicator in High Contrast.
findings.fix: Under forced colors, show the thumb at opacity 1 painted in CanvasText (or fall back to native scrollbars).

findings.subject: scroll-area
findings.summary: No scroll-area baseline shows the scrollbar: hovering and scrolling are never captured.
findings.fix: Add a story with showScrollbarOnHover forced visible (or data-hovering set) so the thumb is captured per theme.

findings.subject: scroll-area
findings.summary: The CLI documents a scroll-area orientation axis that does not exist on the component.
findings.fix: Resolved by the K1 fix.

findings.subject: scrollable-list
findings.summary: The scrollable-list disabled and dragging states have no story or baseline.
findings.evidence: grep -ci disabled scrollable-list.stories.tsx = 0; contract states include disabled, dragging.
findings.fix: Add a disabled story.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel widths are fixed px numbers, so the surface does not grow with text scaling.
findings.fix: Default to rem or content-based widths (for example 12rem / 20rem) and accept CSS lengths in examples.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel scales its content from a physical corner, and titles cannot wrap.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/connected-panel/connected-panel.css content-inner transform-origin: top left / top right; title and summary white-space:nowrap + ellipsis.
findings.fix: Choose the origin from the computed direction (or use logical align data with :dir(rtl) overrides), and allow ConnectedPanelTitle to wrap.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: The connected-panel disabled state has no story or baseline.
findings.evidence: connected-panel.json states include disabled; no disabled story.
findings.fix: Add a disabled trigger story.

findings.subject: connected-panel
findings.summary: ConnectedPanel has no phone story, and its expanded width is a fixed 320px.
findings.fix: Add a 390px story; consider expandedWidth="100%" on phone.

findings.subject: card
findings.summary: The card cursor label uses text-primary as a fill and surface-page as text (a role inversion; both are craft-baseline entries).
findings.fix: Use an inverse-surface pair (or the tooltip tokens) for the pill and drop the baseline entries.

findings.subject: frame
findings.summary: Frame border names overstate their weights: subtle is 20% of border-subtle (near invisible) and strong is plain border-subtle.
findings.fix: YZ to confirm the intended weights; possibly map strong to border-control.

findings.subject: frame
findings.summary: Frame parts take no render prop, so FrameTitle cannot become a heading.
findings.fix: Use useRender on FrameTitle (and the other parts), as Card does.

findings.subject: resizable
findings.summary: Resizable takes two props for one axis (direction and orientation) and a deprecated withHandle boolean.
findings.fix: Deprecate direction and type orientation from the contract.

findings.subject: scrollable-list
findings.summary: The scrollable-list end chevron covers the last visible item, with little visible fade.
findings.fix: YZ to judge; possibly add inline-end padding under the control or a stronger mask.

findings.subject: item
findings.summary: Item sub-parts have no render prop, and the item contract keeps the default / focus synonyms.
findings.fix: Align with the contract-consistency decision (layer 2).

findings.subject: scroll-area
findings.summary: The scroll-area visual quality cannot be judged: the scrollbar thumb, its only drawn part, is invisible in every theme baseline.
findings.fix: Capture the thumb per theme (see the K4 finding), then YZ judges it from the contact sheet.
